いま知っておきたいNPB選手20人 / 20 NPB Players to Know in 2026

Knowing 20 famous names does not automatically teach you baseball. 第2回では2026年8月30日時点の現役選手20人を、power, on-base skill, speed, defense, catcher, starter, strikeout ability, closer, youth, veteran status, and foreign impact という役割で整理する。The goal is to learn what to watch, not simply whom to memorize.
